about:
Dr. Shekhar is the co-founder of Wizgyan. An enterpreneur with several companies under his belt, He still loves to guide and mentor young budding minds as his passion. He is known for his unique teaching methodology that simplifies complex theoretical concepts into intuitive mental models. He has helped over 1,000 students achieve top ranks in competitive exams across India.

His philosophy is: 'Understanding why is more important than knowing what.'
